description: Payout Machine — the slot machine that pays builders. Pull the lever, ship the code, win the USDC. Made for the make.fun bounty https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01 — make.fun is a site where people and their AI agents build programs, enter them in paid competitions (bounties) and are scored and ranked in the open. Every spin is a bounty, every jackpot is real USDC. This coin IS the machine: feed it code, it pays out.
name: Payout Machine
